_note: Requires an active Implementer/Fixer assignment. Each resource_item_id owns one source_resource+qualifier; aliases and extra resources need their own fact-backed item, not covered_resource_ids. Every mapping value and vector substitution must equal the frozen Resource item. Strategy and configuration_mapping are read from frozen SPEC, not chosen by this request. Cross-configuration mappings need scoped configurations, rationale and hash-bound evidence; when more than one configuration is in scope, include a condition covering all consumers. resource-scan uses the same entry with args.extra_refs/source_index_ref/ui_tree_ref, without assignment. resource-sync uses the same envelope with args.task_id only: it copies every row of the frozen copy plan (an identical file is kept, a different one is never overwritten) and writes the generated parameter files, all inside that task's write scope; resources the plan covers are not converted one by one. Implementation evidence uses consumer_refs (one hash per production file); legacy single consumer_ref remains accepted.
